services.name: School Groups
services.desc: Bring your students to the Connecticut Science Center and unlock a day packed with discovery, excitement, and hands-on learning! With over 165 mind-blowing exhibits designed to spark curiosity and align with the Next Generation Science Standards, your students will embark on an unforgettable journey through the wonders of science, technology, and innovation. If a field trip isn’t possible, our Science in Motion Traveling Programs bring the experience to you-with over 50 engaging, NGSS-aligned options including classroom workshops, Assembly Shows, and activity stations-so students can explore, experiment, and stay curious no matter where they are.
